passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My best friend is Tom, and I trust him.
phrases.ko: 나의 가장 친한 친구는 톰이고, 나는 톰을 믿어요.
phrases.zh: 我最好的朋友是汤姆，我信任他。
phrases.py: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng yǒu shì tāng mǔ， wǒ xìn rèn tā。

phrases.en: He always helps me, and I help him too.
phrases.ko: 톰은 항상 나를 도와주고, 나도 톰을 도와요.
phrases.zh: 他总是帮助我，我也帮助他。
phrases.py: tā zǒng shì bāng zhù wǒ， wǒ yě bāng zhù tā。

phrases.en: We laugh every day, and we play every day.
phrases.py: wǒ men měi tiān xiào， yě měi tiān wán。

phrases.en: A true friend is the best kind of friend.
phrases.zh: 真诚的朋友是最好的朋友。
phrases.py: zhēn chéng de péng yǒu shì zuì hǎo de péng yǒu。

phrases.en: I am happy when I am with Tom.
phrases.ko: 나는 톰과 함께 있을 때 행복해요.
phrases.zh: 我和汤姆在一起的时候很快乐。
phrases.py: wǒ hé tāng mǔ zài yì qǐ de shí hòu hěn kuài lè。

phrases.en: We trust each other because we are honest.
phrases.zh: 我们很诚实，所以互相信任。
phrases.py: wǒ men hěn chéng shí， suǒ yǐ hù xiāng xìn rèn。

phrases.en: He always waits for me after school.
phrases.ko: 톰은 방과 후에 항상 나를 기다려요.
phrases.py: fàng xué hòu tā zǒng shì děng wǒ。

phrases.en: We play soccer, and then we laugh.
phrases.zh: 我们踢足球，然后一起笑。
phrases.py: wǒ men tī zú qiú， rán hòu yì qǐ xiào。

phrases.en: A best friend knows when you are sad.
phrases.ko: 가장 친한 친구는 내가 슬플 때를 알아요.
phrases.zh: 最好的朋友知道你什么时候难过。
phrases.py: zuì hǎo de péng yǒu zhī dào nǐ shén me shí hòu nán guò。

phrases.en: I help him, and he helps me.
phrases.ko: 나는 톰을 돕고, 톰은 나를 도와요.
phrases.py: wǒ bāng zhù tā， tā yě bāng zhù wǒ。

phrases.en: Every day with my best friend is a good day.
phrases.ko: 가장 친한 친구와 보내는 매일은 좋은 날이에요.
phrases.zh: 和最好的朋友在一起，每天都是好日子。
phrases.py: hé zuì hǎo de péng yǒu zài yì qǐ， měi tiān dōu shì hǎo rì zi。

full_passage_spoken: My best friend is Tom, and I trust him. He always helps me, and I help him too. We laugh every day, and we play every day. A true friend is the best kind of friend. I am happy when I am with Tom. We trust each other because we are honest. He always waits for me after school. We play soccer, and then we laugh. A best friend knows when you are sad. I help him, and he helps me. Every day with my best friend is a good day.
topic_pinyin: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng yǒu
full_passage_zh: 我最好的朋友是汤姆，我信任他。他总是帮助我，我也帮助他。我们每天笑，也每天玩。真诚的朋友是最好的朋友。我和汤姆在一起的时候很快乐。我们很诚实，所以互相信任。放学后他总是等我。我们踢足球，然后一起笑。最好的朋友知道你什么时候难过。我帮助他，他也帮助我。和最好的朋友在一起，每天都是好日子。
